question: From the first year each actor appeared in a film to the last, how many actors in the database never had a gap longer than three consecutive years without at least one new movie appearance, meaning there is no four-year span anywhere in their active career without at least a single film credit?
sql:
WITH actor_years AS (
    SELECT mc.pid, CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) as year
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN Movie m ON mc.mid = m.mid
    WHERE m.year GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
),
actor_counts AS (
    SELECT pid, COUNT(*) as film_count
    FROM actor_years
    GROUP BY pid
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT pid, year, 
           LAG(year) OVER (PARTITION BY pid ORDER BY year) as prev_year,
           year - LAG(year) OVER (PARTITION BY pid ORDER BY year) as gap
    FROM actor_years
),
max_gaps AS (
    SELECT pid, MAX(gap) as max_gap
    FROM gaps
    WHERE prev_year IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY pid
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actor_counts WHERE film_count = 1) as single_film,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM max_gaps WHERE max_gap <= 4) as multi_film_ok,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actor_counts ac JOIN max_gaps mg ON ac.pid = mg.pid WHERE ac.film_count >= 2 AND mg.max_gap > 4) as multi_film_bad,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actor_counts WHERE film_count >= 2) as total_multi_film
